purpose: Help an agent choose a planning preset without guessing.
selection_rule: Choose the preset that matches the strongest source of certainty. Use hybrid mode only when two sources are truly active.

choose_when: approved image, frame, screenshot, wireframe, or mockup exists
visual fidelity is a success criterion
states and responsive behavior must match a visual source
avoid_when: backend behavior is the main uncertainty
the user is still choosing a product strategy

choose_when: front-end, backend, data, API, auth, permissions, integrations, or deploy are all in scope
the product workflow crosses multiple system boundaries
avoid_when: the work is only a WordPress admin UI
the work is only visual implementation
there is no backend or data model uncertainty

choose_when: WordPress, Elementor, plugins, themes, CPTs, or builder constraints are central
custom code must be justified against existing platform features
avoid_when: the project has no CMS or builder dependency
the task is pure visual static HTML
the work is only external API automation

choose_when: events, triggers, webhooks, APIs, agents, CRMs, sheets, or external systems are central
failure paths and retries are important
monitoring and logs are part of success
avoid_when: the data flow is not yet defined

choose_when: the project is still definition, strategy, methodology, or architecture
the main work is reducing ambiguity
avoid_when: the implementation target is already approved
the user explicitly asked to code now
there is enough certainty to produce executable tasks

allowed_when: one preset owns execution and another owns validation
one preset owns platform constraints and another owns visual fidelity
research strategy is needed only to reduce a known uncertainty

example.forbidden_expansion: Do not turn admin frame implementation into runtime feature development.
